score_contract: finite [B,T,C] preprocessed grouped windows -> [B,T] continuous scores; evaluator handles overlap/threshold/PA
benchmark_acceptance: not_run; CPU behavioral checks do not establish paper performance
assumptions: Paper never specifies training objective, output head, anomaly score, graph neighbors, embedding dimensions/head count or pooling rule.
Dense sensor graph at each timestamp, learned scalar sensor projection, mean node pooling, next-step linear prediction/MSE are chosen and must not be called verified KGL.
Cubic spline with eight grid intervals on [-3,3]; grid/order/initialization not provided in paper.
First window timestamp score is zero because it has no predecessor; evaluator should mask it for prediction track.
epochs10/batch64/width64/heads4 are placeholders; only lr1e-3 and window100 are stated in paper.
Paper dataset counts differ from canonical TAB assets; exact split reproduction unresolved.
